title: 第7章 我最喜欢的就是你了第8章 有靠山怎么了
slug: 大师姐摆烂后带五个道侣飞升了
content_zh:
看到沧溟一直站在原地沉默，江欲又开口催了催：“机不可失失不再来哦。”
沧溟闭眼，反正现在不管是反抗与不反抗都是死路一条，索性准备拼一把。
这么想着，沧溟将身后的长刀解下，掌心紧紧握住刀柄朝着白婉婉挥去。
看到沧溟居然真的敢对自己动手，白婉婉眼里瞬间就露出了几分自不量力的嘲笑。
这个废物是怎么敢听江欲的话的，果然是一个会被江欲哄骗的蠢货。
她抬手想要凝聚灵气抵挡住沧溟的攻击，下一秒脸色却变得奇怪起来，因为她现在的身体好像一个漏了气的气球一样，灵气进来了又会瞬间从身体各处流走。
“我怎么聚集不了我的灵气了！？”
白婉婉下意识转头看向江欲，毕竟在这里能够对她动手的似乎只有江欲一个人了。
虽然按照以前江欲的性子根本不会对自己动手，可是刚刚江欲过来给自己一巴掌的时候她就察觉到了一丝不同寻常。
这个江欲跟以前好像不一样了，从前的她眼神唯唯诺诺的，看到谁都是一副点头哈腰的样子。
可是现在的江欲虽然身体还是臃肿的，但是坐在那里的动作居然让人看出了几分雍容华贵的感觉。
白婉婉意识到自己真的凝聚不了灵气的瞬间，白婉婉就慌乱的抬手想要挡住沧溟的攻击，但是失去了灵气护体的她现在和沧溟一样是个普通人，力气当然没有一直在锻炼的沧溟大。
“啊！！！！”
白婉婉只感觉自己的手臂上传来一阵剧痛，下一秒整个人就像是断了线的风筝一般飞了出去，重重的撞在了府邸的墙壁上。
沧溟这一下的攻击可以说是下了死手，等到白婉婉强撑着站起来的时候，她的手臂已经有大片的青紫。
“我，我居然真的把白婉婉打伤了？”
在看到地上狼狈的人时，沧溟眼睛都因为不敢相信瞪大了。
他一个普通人怎么可能会打得过一个筑基后期的修真者，除非是江欲做了什么。
沧溟脑海里浮现出刚刚江欲叫自己攻击她的时候脸上势在必得的笑容，转头盯着坐在桌子上的人。
“怎么了？”

在看戏的江欲察觉到沧溟的眼神，冲着对面的人挑了挑眉：“是突然发现我比白婉婉好看多了吗？”
“还是因为能报仇太高兴了，想要报答我？”
江欲不要脸的话瞬间就让沧溟内心浮现出的一丝丝好感瞬间消失，有些无语的转头开口道：“不要以为你给我这么一点好处就能让我觉得你好。”
要是原主江欲被沧溟这样的态度挑衅，她可能就要把他关进禁闭室惩罚了。
但是现在的江欲可不会这么对他，只是用宠溺的眼光看着面前的人。
“没事，你不感谢我也没关系，谁让你是我的道侣里面最好看的，我宠你。”
沧溟再一次被江欲的话震惊，以前的江欲怎么可能会说出这么肉麻的话，不想着每天把他们身上值钱的东西送给别人就不错了。
“什么叫宠着我，你知不知道我……”
content_en:
Seeing that Cang Ming had been standing there silently, Jiang Yu urged him again: "This opportunity must not be missed before it comes back."
Cangming closed his eyes. Anyway, whether he resisted or not, it was a dead end, so he simply prepared to give it a try.
With this in mind, Cangming took off the long knife behind him, held the handle of the knife tightly in his palm, and swung it towards Bai Wanwan.
Seeing that Cangming actually dared to attack her, Bai Wanwan's eyes instantly showed a bit of overestimation and ridicule.
How dare this loser listen to Jiang Yu? He is indeed a fool who will be deceived by Jiang Yu.
She raised her hand to gather her spiritual energy to resist Cang Ming's attack, but her face turned strange the next second, because her body was like a deflated balloon. Once her spiritual energy came in, it would instantly flow out of her body.
"Why can't I gather my spiritual energy!?"
Bai Wanwan subconsciously turned to look at Jiang Yu. After all, Jiang Yu seemed to be the only one who could do something to her here.
Although according to Jiang Yu's temper in the past, he would never do anything to her, she noticed something unusual when Jiang Yu came over and slapped her.
This Jiang Yu seems to be different from before. In the past, her eyes were submissive and she nodded and bowed to everyone she saw.
But now, although Jiang Yu's body is still bloated, the way he sits there actually makes people feel a bit graceful and luxurious.
The moment Bai Wanwan realized that she really couldn't gather her spiritual energy, Bai Wanwan raised her hands in panic to block Cangming's attack. However, without the spiritual energy protection, she was now an ordinary person like Cangming. Of course, she was not as strong as Cangming who had been exercising.
"Ah!!!!"
Bai Wanwan felt a sharp pain in her arm, and the next second she flew out like a kite with its string broken, hitting the wall of the mansion heavily.
Cangming's attack could be said to be a fatal blow. By the time Bai Wanwan managed to stand up, her arms were already covered in large bruises.
"I, I actually injured Bai Wanwan?"
When he saw the embarrassed man on the ground, Cangming's eyes widened in disbelief.
How could he, an ordinary person, defeat a cultivator in the late stage of foundation building, unless Jiang Yu did something.
Cangming's mind flashed back to the inevitable smile on Jiang Yu's face when he had just told him to attack her, and he turned to stare at the person sitting on the table.
"What's wrong?"
Jiang Yu, who was watching the show, noticed Cang Ming's eyes and raised his eyebrows at the person opposite: "Did you suddenly realize that I am much prettier than Bai Wanwan?"
"Or are you too happy to get revenge and want to repay me?"
Jiang Yu's shameless words instantly made the traces of good feelings that emerged in Cangming's heart disappear instantly. He turned around speechlessly and said, "Don't think that you can make me think you are good by giving me such a small benefit."
If the original owner Jiang Yu was provoked by Cang Ming's attitude, she might put him in a solitary room for punishment.
But now Jiang Yu would not treat him like this, he would just look at the person in front of him with doting eyes.
"It's okay. It doesn't matter if you don't thank me. You are the most beautiful among my Taoist companions. I love you."
Cangming was once again shocked by Jiang Yu's words. How could Jiang Yu say such disgusting words in the past? It would be nice if he didn't want to give their valuable things to others every day.
"What do you mean by pampering me? Do you know that I..."
